sections.title: Emergent frustrated magnetism in strain-patterned graphene
sections.abstract: Strain-patterned graphene is reported to develop interaction-driven insulating behavior, anisotropic magnetic hysteresis, slow relaxation, and magnetic textures consistent with frustrated magnetism generated by correlated electrons.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim that lithographically patterned strain and its pseudo-magnetic field can create frustrated magnetism in otherwise non-magnetic graphene.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; transport, cryogenic magnetic-force microscopy, and Monte Carlo modeling
sections.caveat: The abstract describes qualitative agreement with simulations rather than a complete microscopic identification of the magnetic ground state.

sections.title: Quantum environment afterglow from broadband excitation spectroscopy in superconducting qubits
sections.abstract: Time-resolved broadband excitation spectroscopy is used to reconstruct qubit noise spectra, separate quantum from classical noise, and identify long-lived two-level systems whose memory can make superconducting-qubit behavior non-Markovian.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim that long-lived two-level systems can retain excitation for tens of microseconds to milliseconds and leave a memory of prior qubit dynamics across many operation cycles.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; broadband spectroscopy, postselection, feed-forward, and reconstructed noise power spectral density
sections.caveat: The reported interpretation depends on separating quantum and classical noise and on the device-specific environment.

sections.title: Observation of the electronic Pomeranchuk effect in generalized Wigner crystals of twisted MoS2
sections.abstract: Transport in twisted bilayer MoS2 is reported to show an electronic Pomeranchuk effect, in which heating at fractional fillings drives a compressible itinerant state toward a localized generalized Wigner crystal.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim that isospin entropy stabilizes a localized generalized Wigner-crystal state at elevated temperature.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; low-temperature transport in AB-stacked twisted bilayer MoS2
sections.caveat: The phase assignment and entropy interpretation depend on filling, twist angle, and device conditions.

sections.title: Impact of magnetic drift configuration on the edge radial electric field in the TCV tokamak
sections.abstract: Matched TCV tokamak discharges with opposite magnetic-drift directions show a robust difference in the edge radial electric field, with the favorable configuration producing stronger shear as the plasma approaches the L–H transition.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim that magnetic-drift configuration changes the edge radial-electric-field well and associated E×B shear in TCV.
sections.caveat: The abstract reports a plausible connection to confinement and H-mode access, not a demonstrated causal mechanism.

sections.title: Bayesian inference of non-Maxwellian distribution functions from collective Thomson scattering spectra
sections.abstract: A Bayesian model-selection framework is tested on synthetic collective-Thomson-scattering spectra to infer non-Maxwellian electron distributions and quantify uncertainty in their characteristic features.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim that model evidence can select an adequate candidate distribution and that posterior densities can expose non-Maxwellian features and their uncertainties.
sections.evidence_type: computational; Bayesian inference on synthetic collective Thomson-scattering spectra
sections.caveat: The validation is synthetic and includes the favorable case where the true model is among the candidates.
